create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, -1.0])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/Conveyor", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Props/Conveyors/ConveyorBelt_A09.usd")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysicsRigidBodyAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physics:kinematicEnabled", value=True)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", schema_name="PhysxSurfaceVelocityAPI")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocity", value=[0.2, 0.0, 0.0])
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt", attr_name="physxSurfaceVelocity:surfaceVelocityEnabled", value=True)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/EndStop", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.03, 0.0, 0.82], scale=[0.01, 0.45, 0.05])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/EndStop", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, 0.0, 0.375], scale=[0.15, 0.15, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.02, 0.0, 0.806], size=0.05)

    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/BinSupport", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.5, -0.5, 0.375], scale=[0.2, 0.2, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/BinSupport", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin", position=[0.5, -0.5, 0.75], size=[0.3, 0.3, 0.12])

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.85], size=[0.08, 0.08, 0.14])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path="/World/Conveyor/Belt",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/Bin",
    planning_obstacles=["/World/EndStop", "/World/Bin"],
